# IP pool and L2 announcement for vuoro-shared/actionq-pg (service-lb.yaml).
# Moved from apps/actionq-db when that app was dropped (S2 item 7).
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool
metadata:
  name: actionq-pg
spec:
  serviceSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: actionq-pg
  blocks:
    - start: ${ACTIONQ_LB_IP}
      stop: ${ACTIONQ_LB_IP}
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2alpha1
kind: CiliumL2AnnouncementPolicy
metadata:
  name: actionq-pg
spec:
  interfaces:
    - eno1
  loadBalancerIPs: true
  nodeSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
        operator: In
        values:
          - k8s-worker-gpu-1
  serviceSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: actionq-pg
